name: Team Bulbasaur: Spectral Grounding & Slumbering Fortress
archetype: Ghost immunity pivoting, Sleep status control, and Dark physical wallbreaking.
gym_duel_rationale: Morty's 5v5 Ghost hybrid battle prompts the player to select 5 active Pokémon: Venusaur/Charizard levels to Cap 67 to anchor the frontline, using STAB Flamethrower to burn down Weavile/Shedinja and using Sleep Powder to neutralize Snorlax/Aegislash's Swords Dance setup; Gyarados/Arbok enters to trigger Intimidate, dropping Hitmonchan/Dusknoir's Attack while using STAB Crunch against Snorlax/Aegislash and Clefable/Spiritomb; Alakazam/Weezing dismantles Clefable/Spiritomb with super-effective Sludge Bomb and hits Hitmonchan/Dusknoir with STAB Psychic; Snorlax brings complete 100% immunity to all Ghost-type attacks (Shadow Ball, Shadow Punch, Shadow Claw deal zero damage!), freely tanking hits and crushing Snorlax/Aegislash with super-effective Crunch; and Pidgeot leverages its Normal typing for Ghost immunity while striking Hitmonchan/Dusknoir with super-effective Air Slash.

roster.progression_notes: 530 BST starter hybrid elevated to Cap 67. STAB Flamethrower melts Weavile/Shedinja instantly. Sleep Powder pacifies setup sweepers.
513 BST Intimidate pivot. Drops Hitmonchan/Dusknoir's Attack on switch-in. STAB Crunch deals crushing super-effective damage to Snorlax/Aegislash.
495 BST special sweeper with 118 SpA. STAB Sludge Bomb effortlessly obliterates Clefable/Spiritomb, while STAB Psychic targets Hitmonchan/Dusknoir.
Colossal 160 HP tank. 100% immune to Ghost moves, completely nullifying Morty's Shadow Balls. Super-effective Crunch destroys Snorlax/Aegislash.
Ghost-immune Flying scout. Immune to all Ghost attacks. STAB Air Slash targets Hitmonchan/Dusknoir's Flying weakness for heavy damage.
500 BST physical bruiser. Retained for route water offense with Crabhammer; benched during Morty's duel due to Ghost fighting immunities.

flex_bench.rationale: 97.5% accurate Sleep Powder and Quiver Dance setup against bulky route trainers.
High-speed Electric coverage packing Discharge and Light Screen against opposing aerial foes.
High Jump Kick physical breaker capable of substituting into the active party for Fighting STAB.
